resumeText:

EXPERIENCE

- Ran a JMeter test with 200 virtual users on the login API before a festive sale.
- Write test plans and test cases for each release.
- Present test results to the product team in the sprint review.

EDUCATION
BTech Electronics, JNTU Hyderabad, 2022

SKILLS
Java, Selenium, TestNG, Postman, JMeter, Jenkins, Git
